native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the stone carrying the smallest owed letter (select the minimum tentative distance among reached, unlocked nodes).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by what its thief is owed, one direction at a time (directed, per-edge non-negative weight relaxation from the current house).

A locked garden letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped and thrown away (settled nodes are final; invalid/self-loop edges are discarded and unreachable nodes stay at infinity).

In-place re-chalking of a stone still in the garden: a knot of three threads detached and recast with the lower number without moving the stone (O(1) decrease-key by overwriting the candidate's value in place).
core_technique: Dijkstra's algorithm over a CSR adjacency, selecting the minimum by a SIMD/linear scan over a compact array of reached-but-unsettled nodes (array-scan variant with O(1) in-place decrease-key), with a work-budget/regime switch to a standard binary-heap Dijkstra.
